arithmetic.authoritative_field: Q exact rational arithmetic (fractions.Fraction); no floating comparison defines a role
arithmetic.boundary_coordinate: Stage-A x6,y6 integer scaled-Cartesian coordinates representing physical (X,sqrt(3)Y) with X=x6/6,Y=y6/6
arithmetic.phase_center: frozen rational axial phase c; evaluate w=x-c exactly
arithmetic.scaled_cartesian_to_axial: a=(x6-y6)/6; b=y6/3, extended exactly to rational x6,y6 for midpoints
arithmetic.teacher_axes: d is frozen primitive discovery orientation; p is frozen primitive perpendicular from Stage 0

packet_role_classifier.AMBIGUOUS_ROLE: all other cases, including opposite signed sides, more than one corner pair, point ambiguity, or unresolved single-family mixture
packet_role_classifier.CORNER_NEAR: there is one unique adjacent signed D/P side pair such that every tested point is associated with one member of that pair or its exact pair-tie, and the packet contains evidence for both side families either by both unique side associations or by at least one exact pair-tie
packet_role_classifier.SIDE_INTERIOR: every tested point has the same unique signed teacher-side association and no adjacent-side tie
packet_role_classifier.corner_index_storage: a deterministic signed D/P pair may be stored only as interpretation metadata after this protocol freeze; it is never grammar input

point_support_association.adjacent_side_tie: E_d=E_p and both beta values nonzero; tie identifies the unique adjacent D-sign/P-sign side pair
point_support_association.interpretation: exact normalized squared support-coordinate extremity; used only as a deterministic supporting-side association, not asserted to be Euclidean metric distance
point_support_association.tie_rule: Fraction equality only; no tolerance, perturbation, or floating fallback

symmetry_covariance.required: simultaneously transform teacher center/axes and packet geometry under frozen triangular-lattice D6; coarse role SIDE_INTERIOR/CORNER_NEAR/AMBIGUOUS_ROLE must be invariant while signed side identifiers may permute
symmetry_covariance.square_axis_swap: swapping d and p may permute signed side identifiers but must preserve coarse role

tested_packet_points.reason: requires the full frozen local boundary carrier without importing a teacher corner distance threshold
tested_packet_points.set: all ordered packet vertices v_0..v_k AND all k exposed-edge midpoints m_i=(v_i+v_{i+1})/2
